notes: REQ-2.3.1 builds on REQ-2.2 (home page at /, composer, note cards). The system contains a deletable regular (unpinned) note seeded server-side with title 'Delete me 2.3.1' (fixture data; must exist on every fresh start, so the seed lives in store.js defaultData() and backend/data/db.json). The delete flow reuses the existing More options dropdown: hovering a note card reveals a 'More' icon button (aria-label/title 'More'); clicking it opens the dropdown menu with 'Delete note' as a menu item. Choosing 'Delete note' calls the existing DELETE /api/notes/:id endpoint (hard delete, no confirmation dialog) and removes the note from the client state and the main notes list immediately, then shows a toast notification ('Note deleted') with an 'Undo' button (restores the note via POST /api/notes with the original id). CSS fix: .note-actions previously used opacity:0 for the hover reveal, which Playwright treats as visible and would resolve the FIRST card's More button instead of the hovered one; switched to display:none / display:flex on .note-card:hover so only the hovered card's actions are exposed. No new routes, no schema changes; REQ-1.1/2.1/2.2 features untouched.
